newsitem.title: INDIA: India Wipro up 6 pct before bonus meet.
newsitem.headline: India Wipro up 6 pct before bonus meet.

text.p: Shares of diversified firm, Wipro Ltd. rose 49.50 rupees, or six percent, to 889.0 in Monday afternoon trade at the Bombay bourse ahead of the firm's board meeting this week to consider a bonus issue, traders said.
The board of directors of Wipro are due to meet on August 1 to consider a bonus share issue.
The company's shares have doubled in the last two months on market rumours of the bonus issue.

Earlier this month, Wipro Infotech, a diversified computer hardware and software company which is an affiliate of Wipro Ltd topped the list of top 20 Indian computer companies ranked on annual sales, according to Dataquest magazine.

India's leading industry magazine said Wipro notched sales of 8.7 billoin rupees in 1996/97 (April-March) followed by software exporter Tata Consultancy Services netting revenues at 7.21 billion rupees.
